CRISIS_MEDICAL_DEFICIT.description: Settlement lacks any active medical apothecary or healing infirmary.
CRISIS_MEDICAL_DEFICIT.council_order_title: CIVIC MANDATE: Emergency Healing Clinic Commissioned
CRISIS_MEDICAL_DEFICIT.council_order_body: By municipal council decree, an emergency healing clinic has been funded to triage injured and sick citizens.

CRISIS_FIRE_HAZARD.description: Recent building destruction by fire or arson threatens settlement safety.
CRISIS_FIRE_HAZARD.council_order_title: MUNICIPAL PROTECTION: Fire Watchtower & Brigade Station Erected
CRISIS_FIRE_HAZARD.council_order_body: In response to catastrophic fire, the town council has established an alarm tower and firefighting water depot.

CRISIS_CRIME_EPIDEMIC.description: Criminal activity or underworld dens have surged beyond acceptable tolerance.
CRISIS_CRIME_EPIDEMIC.council_order_title: LAW ENFORCEMENT ORDER: Garrison Security Checkpoint Deployed
CRISIS_CRIME_EPIDEMIC.council_order_body: Town guards have fortified district thoroughfares with street lighting and armed checkpoints to suppress illicit operations.

CRISIS_HOUSING_SHORTAGE.description: Homeless and displaced population exceeds civic tolerance.
CRISIS_HOUSING_SHORTAGE.council_order_title: HOUSING RELIEF: Municipal Worker Tenements Constructed
CRISIS_HOUSING_SHORTAGE.council_order_body: The town council has allocated treasury funds to construct subsidized worker tenement lodgings.
